summary: Scope, numbers, completion boundary and the bans on fake descriptive items / key-only new types match current decisions and source. But R1 claims loader properties (ledger-before-write, halt on same externalId with different content, new-keys-only loading, a safe namespace for native descriptive items) that the existing loader does not have. These must be written into the plan as pre-write gates before any DB write.

mandatoryConditions.text: Restrict loading to an allowlist of new elem form ids / mid type keys. Dry-run must show inserts only for new keys, 0 inserts into existing families, total <=138, before --apply.

Fix a distinct externalId prefix and familyKey namespace for native descriptive items in the plan. Lock with tests that delete-derived-descriptive.ts does not target them, extend the revert prefix check, add a separate counter in checkUnloadedTypes.ts, and state how refresh-engine-content.ts treats them.

For rows whose externalId already exists, compare digests of content/answer/solution/figureSvg with regenerated rows and halt before any write on mismatch. Count a rerun's 'new 0' as idempotency evidence only after that comparison.

Ledger before write: commit the batch manifest (externalIds + digests) before --apply and document recovery by externalId; and/or flush the ledger per row for this batch (FLUSH_EVERY=200 > 138 means no ledger exists until the end).

Define the batch SHA: dry-run emits per-row externalId, unitId, familyKey, questionType, difficulty, sha256(content||answer||solution||figureSvg). Claude's final review uses that manifest plus renders. --apply refuses if any regenerated digest differs. Record the manifest SHA-256 in the final approval.
Revert must not delete rows referenced by tests/answer sheets/reviews/reports. Lock them (directUseAllowed=false) and report, as delete-derived-descriptive.ts does.

recommendations.text: State why these 4 중3 units were chosen; 원과 현 and 이차함수의 최댓값과 최솟값 have 10 families (fewer than the chosen 11).

findings.text: 초4 target units' 5-sheet distinct-stem capacity 36/36/38/32, families 10/10/11/10; all other 초4 units >=40
중3 target units have 11 families, 0 descriptive, strict default tier 6/6/6/7 of 8; all registered middle types are loaded (unloaded ledger empty), so new types need new authoring
Family id is not a certified math type; 20 items is a comparison scenario only

Elem loader selects by section and expands every form; mid loader slices first N types by maxTypes, with no key filter. The externalId embeds the seed, so a different seedBase adds rows to existing families.

delete-derived-descriptive.ts deletes every 서술형 with family_key elem:/mid:. Revert rejects non-engine-(elem|mid|mid-combo|mid-judge) prefixes. checkUnloadedTypes counts only registeredTypes/combo/judge. The plan's list at L89 omits revert and the deleter.
Existing externalIds are filtered out without comparing content; the loader neither overwrites nor halts
Rows are inserted one by one outside a transaction. The ledger is flushed every 200 rows and once at the end, so a 138-row batch has no ledger until it completes.
The loader regenerates rows from code at --apply. The plan's 'batch SHA' has no defined object, so the reviewed candidates are not bound to the written rows.
Revert deleteMany's ledger ids regardless of references. Engine rows are approved and directUseAllowed immediately, so they can be referenced before a revert.
Shared DB write gate exists; loader re-reads inserted rows and checks requested state
